summaries.en: Wav2Vec2-large-xlsr-hindi is a fine-tuned automatic speech recognition model that converts Hindi speech to text, addressing the need for accurate transcription in one of the world's most spoken languages. It builds on Facebook's Wav2Vec2 architecture, which learns directly from raw audio through self-supervised pre-training, enabling robust performance even with limited labeled data. You can use it via Hugging Face's Transformers library to transcribe audio files, integrate into voice assistants, or build applications for education, accessibility, or content analysis in Hindi.
summaries.zh: Wav2Vec2-large-xlsr-hindi 是一个针对印地语优化的自动语音识别模型，能将口语转换为文本，解决这一全球主要语言缺乏高质量转录工具的问题。其技术核心基于Wav2Vec2架构，通过自监督学习从原始音频中直接提取特征，无需大量标注数据就能有效捕捉语音模式，特别适合资源有限的语种。开发者可通过Hugging Face平台快速调用该模型，用于构建语音助手、教育工具、无障碍应用或内容分析系统，为印地语数字生态提供基础支持。
